w: Popularly conceived as being made of silver, Cerro Rico supplied roughly 85 percent of all silver mined in the central Andes under Spain -- wealth that made Potosi one of the New World's largest cities. Simon Bolivar reputedly waved a flag from its summit; Bolivia's arms later added a condor, alpaca and the mountain.
s: The silver mountain that built Potosi.
